policy_params_note: P4/P6 margins (deadline_margin_frac 0.08, slack feedback, anchored time model) were set after 60 s S1 pilot runs (seeds 1-3) showed ~0.2% T4 misses at 0.05; see power/README.md.
labels: VX-1 is a fictional SoC; every power parameter is an assumption (power/params_vx1.yaml).
P6ph uses a PLACEHOLDER conservative finish-time bound; P6 uses the conformal surrogate (surrogate/p6.py, a calibrated heuristic with marginal coverage, not a per-job guarantee).
P4G (pace plus idle gating) is an extra variant, not one of the spec's P0-P6.
P5 is a lower bound under this energy model, computed per run on that run's job trace; leakage at ambient.
Robot behavior comes from a scripted expert in hybrid mode; VLA compute is modeled from its operator graph.
